<|user|>Make me an endless runner game like Subway Surfers with three lanes, an orange player that switches lanes with the left and right arrow keys, red obstacles, yellow coins to collect and a score, slow<|end|><|assistant|><!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Runner</title>
<style>
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: #f5f5f7;
  color: #1f2937;
}
canvas {
  border-radius: 10px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="360" height="520"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const lanes = [W / 6, W / 2, (W * 5) / 6];
let lane = 1;
let px = lanes[1];
let things = [];
let score = 0;
let best = 0;
let speed = 3;
let tick = 0;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" && lane > 0) lane--;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight" && lane < 2) lane++;
});
function reset() {
  best = Math.max(best, score);
  score = 0;
  speed = 3;
  things = [];
}
function spawn() {
  const l = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
  const coin = Math.random() < 0.4;
  things.push({ x: lanes[l], y: -40, coin });
}
function loop() {
  tick++;
  if (tick % Math.max(18, Math.floor(60 - speed * 4)) === 0) spawn();
  px += (lanes[lane] - px) * 0.25;
  speed += 0.002;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1f2937";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#374151";
  ctx.setLineDash([16, 16]);
  ctx.lineDashOffset = -tick * speed;
  for (const x of [W / 3, (W * 2) / 3]) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  for (const t of things) {
    t.y += speed;
    if (t.coin) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#dc2626";
      ctx.fillRect(t.x - 28, t.y - 18, 56, 36);
    }
    if (Math.abs(t.y - (H - 60)) < 28 && Math.abs(t.x - px) < 30) {
      if (t.coin) {
        score += 10;
        t.y = H + 100;
      } else {
        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    }
  }
  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ea580c";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
<|end|>

<|user|>Make a game where I catch falling raindrops with a purple basket using the mouse or arrow keys, counting caught and missed.<|end|><|assistant|><!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Catch</title>
<style>
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: #f5f5f7;

  border-radius: 10px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="420" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const basket = { x: W / 2 - 40, w: 80 };
let drops = [];
let score = 0;
let missed = 0;
let frame = 0;
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  basket.x = e.offsetX - basket.w / 2;
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") basket.x -= 30;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") basket.x += 30;
});
function loop() {
  if (frame++ % 40 === 0) drops.push({ x: 20 + Math.random() * (W - 40), y: -10, v: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
  for (const d of drops) {
    d.y += d.v;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    if (d.y > H - 30 && d.x > basket.x && d.x < basket.x + basket.w) {
      d.y = H + 100;
      score++;
    } else if (d.y > H && d.y < H + 50) {
      d.y = H + 100;
      missed++;
    }
  }
  drops = drops.filter((d) => d.y < H + 60);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9333ea";
  ctx.fillRect(basket.x, H - 24, basket.w, 16);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Caught: " + score + "   Missed: " + missed, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

<|user|>Can you make a Breakout game with 5 rows of gray bricks, a purple paddle controlled with the mouse or arrow keys and a score<|end|><|assistant|><!DOCTYPE html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Breakout</title>
<style>
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: #f5f5f7;
  color: #1f2937;
}
canvas {
  border-radius: 10px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="400"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const paddle = { x: W / 2 - 40, w: 80 };
let ball;
let bricks;
let score = 0;
function reset() {
  ball = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, vx: 3, vy: -3 };
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < 5; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) bricks.push({ x: 10 + c * 58, y: 40 + r * 24, alive: true, color: "#4b5563" });
  score = 0;
}
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  paddle.x = e.offsetX - paddle.w / 2;
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") paddle.x -= 30;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") paddle.x += 30;
});
function loop() {
  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;
  if (ball.x < 8 || ball.x > W - 8) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.y < 8) ball.vy *= -1;
  if (ball.y > H - 30 && ball.x > paddle.x && ball.x < paddle.x + paddle.w && ball.vy > 0) ball.vy *= -1;
  if (ball.y > H) reset();
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (b.alive && ball.x > b.x && ball.x < b.x + 52 && ball.y > b.y && ball.y < b.y + 18) {
      b.alive = false;
      ball.vy *= -1;
      score++;
    }
  }
  if (bricks.every((b) => !b.alive)) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, 52, 18);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9333ea";
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, H - 24, paddle.w, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
<|end|>

function reset() {
  ball = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, vx: 3, vy: -3 };
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < 4; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) bricks.push({ x: 10 + c * 58, y: 40 + r * 24, alive: true, color: `hsl(${r * 90}, 80%, 55%)` });

      ball.vy *= -1;

  if (bricks.every((b) => !b.alive)) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, 52, 18);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#16a34a";
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, H - 24, paddle.w, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

loop();
</script>

        t.y = H + 100;
      } else {
        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    }

  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#db2777";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";

}

loop();

<canvas id="c" width="360" height="520"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const lanes = [W / 6, W / 2, (W * 5) / 6];
let lane = 1;
let px = lanes[1];
let things = [];
let score = 0;
let best = 0;
let speed = 4.5;
let tick = 0;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" && lane > 0) lane--;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight" && lane < 2) lane++;
});
function reset() {
  best = Math.max(best, score);
  score = 0;
  speed = 4.5;
  things = [];
}
function spawn() {
  const l = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
  const coin = Math.random() < 0.4;
  things.push({ x: lanes[l], y: -40, coin });
}
function loop() {
  tick++;
  if (tick % Math.max(18, Math.floor(60 - speed * 4)) === 0) spawn();
  px += (lanes[lane] - px) * 0.25;
  speed += 0.002;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1f2937";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.strokeStyle = "#374151";
  ctx.setLineDash([16, 16]);
  ctx.lineDashOffset = -tick * speed;
  for (const x of [W / 3, (W * 2) / 3]) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  for (const t of things) {
    t.y += speed;
    if (t.coin) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5563";
      ctx.fillRect(t.x - 28, t.y - 18, 56, 36);
    }
    if (Math.abs(t.y - (H - 60)) < 28 && Math.abs(t.x - px) < 30) {
      if (t.coin) {
        score += 10;
        t.y = H + 100;
      } else {
        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    }
  }
  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4f46e5";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>

  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

loop();

body {

  min-height: 100vh;

  place-items: center;

  border-radius: 10px;

<body>
<canvas id="c" width="480" height="400"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const paddle = { x: W / 2 - 40, w: 80 };
let ball;
let bricks;
let score = 0;
function reset() {
  ball = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, vx: 3, vy: -3 };
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < 5; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) bricks.push({ x: 10 + c * 58, y: 40 + r * 24, alive: true, color: "#2563eb" });
  score = 0;
}
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  paddle.x = e.offsetX - paddle.w / 2;
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") paddle.x -= 30;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") paddle.x += 30;
});
function loop() {
  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;
  if (ball.x < 8 || ball.x > W - 8) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.y < 8) ball.vy *= -1;
  if (ball.y > H - 30 && ball.x > paddle.x && ball.x < paddle.x + paddle.w && ball.vy > 0) ball.vy *= -1;
  if (ball.y > H) reset();
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (b.alive && ball.x > b.x && ball.x < b.x + 52 && ball.y > b.y && ball.y < b.y + 18) {
      b.alive = false;
      ball.vy *= -1;
      score++;
    }
  }
  if (bricks.every((b) => !b.alive)) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, 52, 18);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#dc2626";
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, H - 24, paddle.w, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

const lanes = [W / 6, W / 2, (W * 5) / 6];
let lane = 1;
let px = lanes[1];
let things = [];
let score = 0;
let best = 0;
let speed = 4.5;
let tick = 0;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" && lane > 0) lane--;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight" && lane < 2) lane++;
});
function reset() {
  best = Math.max(best, score);
  score = 0;
  speed = 4.5;
  things = [];

  const coin = Math.random() < 0.4;
  things.push({ x: lanes[l], y: -40, coin });
}

  tick++;
  if (tick % Math.max(18, Math.floor(60 - speed * 4)) === 0) spawn();

    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();

  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  for (const t of things) {
    t.y += speed;
    if (t.coin) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#db2777";
      ctx.fillRect(t.x - 28, t.y - 18, 56, 36);
    }
    if (Math.abs(t.y - (H - 60)) < 28 && Math.abs(t.x - px) < 30) {
      if (t.coin) {
        score += 10;
        t.y = H + 100;
      } else {
        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    }
  }
  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5563";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9333ea";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);

const H = canvas.height;
const player = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, vx: 4, vy: 3, r: 8 };
let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;
});
document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});
function reset() {
  ball.x = W / 2;
  ball.y = H / 2;
  ball.vx = 4 * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
  ball.vy = 3;
}
function loop() {
  if (up) player.y -= 5;
  if (down) player.y += 5;
  player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - player.h, player.y));
  ai.y += (ball.y - (ai.y + ai.h / 2)) * 0.06;
  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;
  if (ball.y < ball.r || ball.y > H - ball.r) ball.vy *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 24 && ball.y > player.y && ball.y < player.y + player.h && ball.vx < 0) {
    ball.vx *= -1.05;
    score++;
  }
  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();

  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2563eb";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();

let down = false;

  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";

}

        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }

  score += 0.1;

  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);

  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);

}

let ball;
let bricks;
let score = 0;
function reset() {
  ball = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, vx: 3, vy: -3 };
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) bricks.push({ x: 10 + c * 58, y: 40 + r * 24, alive: true, color: `hsl(${r * 120}, 80%, 55%)` });

      ball.vy *= -1;

  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, 52, 18);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5563";
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, H - 24, paddle.w, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>

let ball;
let bricks;
let score = 0;
function reset() {
  ball = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, vx: 3, vy: -3 };
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < 4; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) bricks.push({ x: 10 + c * 58, y: 40 + r * 24, alive: true, color: "#dc2626" });

  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") paddle.x += 30;

      b.alive = false;
      ball.vy *= -1;
      score++;

  if (bricks.every((b) => !b.alive)) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, 52, 18);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4f46e5";
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, H - 24, paddle.w, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>

    t.y += speed;

let down = false;

  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;

  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);

  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);

  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

</script>

        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);

  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ea580c";

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);

const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const basket = { x: W / 2 - 40, w: 80 };
let drops = [];
let score = 0;
let missed = 0;
let frame = 0;
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  basket.x = e.offsetX - basket.w / 2;
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") basket.x -= 30;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") basket.x += 30;
});
function loop() {

  ctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
  for (const d of drops) {
    d.y += d.v;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    if (d.y > H - 30 && d.x > basket.x && d.x < basket.x + basket.w) {
      d.y = H + 100;
      score++;
    } else if (d.y > H && d.y < H + 50) {
      d.y = H + 100;
      missed++;
    }
  }
  drops = drops.filter((d) => d.y < H + 60);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#db2777";
  ctx.fillRect(basket.x, H - 24, basket.w, 16);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Caught: " + score + "   Missed: " + missed, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

  const coin = Math.random() < 0.4;

}

  tick++;
  if (tick % Math.max(18, Math.floor(60 - speed * 4)) === 0) spawn();
  px += (lanes[lane] - px) * 0.25;
  speed += 0.002;

    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();

      if (t.coin) {
        score += 10;
        t.y = H + 100;
      } else {
        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    }
  }
  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2563eb";

const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };

let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;

  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;

  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;

  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#eab308";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9333ea";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

loop();

const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };

  if (ball.x < 0) {

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

const canvas = document.getElementById("c");

const paddle = { x: W / 2 - 40, w: 80 };
let ball;
let bricks;
let score = 0;
function reset() {
  ball = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, vx: 3, vy: -3 };
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) bricks.push({ x: 10 + c * 58, y: 40 + r * 24, alive: true, color: "#ea580c" });

  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") paddle.x += 30;

function loop() {
  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;

      b.alive = false;
      ball.vy *= -1;
      score++;
    }
  }
  if (bricks.every((b) => !b.alive)) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, 52, 18);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5563";
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, H - 24, paddle.w, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>

body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;

<canvas id="c" width="480" height="400"></canvas>

const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const paddle = { x: W / 2 - 40, w: 80 };
let ball;
let bricks;
let score = 0;
function reset() {
  ball = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, vx: 3, vy: -3 };
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < 5; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) bricks.push({ x: 10 + c * 58, y: 40 + r * 24, alive: true, color: `hsl(${r * 72}, 80%, 55%)` });
  score = 0;
}
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  paddle.x = e.offsetX - paddle.w / 2;
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") paddle.x -= 30;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") paddle.x += 30;
});
function loop() {
  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;
  if (ball.x < 8 || ball.x > W - 8) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.y < 8) ball.vy *= -1;

    if (b.alive && ball.x > b.x && ball.x < b.x + 52 && ball.y > b.y && ball.y < b.y + 18) {
      b.alive = false;
      ball.vy *= -1;
      score++;
    }
  }
  if (bricks.every((b) => !b.alive)) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, 52, 18);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2563eb";
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, H - 24, paddle.w, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>

        t.y = H + 100;
      } else {
        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    }

  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2563eb";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);

}

  score = 0;

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 28px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 8, 50);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

loop();
</script>

  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";

<body>
<button class="btn" id="go">Click me</button>
<canvas id="c"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
canvas.width = innerWidth;
canvas.height = innerHeight;
let bits = [];
document.getElementById("go").addEventListener("click", (e) => {
  for (let i = 0; i < 40; i++) {
    bits.push({
      x: e.clientX,
      y: e.clientY,
      vx: (Math.random() - 0.5) * 12,
      vy: -Math.random() * 12 - 4,
      s: 4 + Math.random() * 6,
      c: `hsl(${Math.random() * 360}, 90%, 60%)`,
      r: Math.random() * 6,

  }
});

  for (const b of bits) {

    b.x += b.vx;
    b.y += b.vy;
    b.r += 0.1;
    ctx.save();
    ctx.translate(b.x, b.y);
    ctx.rotate(b.r);
    ctx.fillStyle = b.c;

}

    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, 52, 18);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9333ea";
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, H - 24, paddle.w, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>

      if (t.coin) {
        score += 10;
        t.y = H + 100;
      } else {
        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    }
  }
  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#db2777";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);

  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

  balls.push({
    x: 40 + Math.random() * 320,
    y: 40 + Math.random() * 220,
    vx: (3 + Math.random()) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1),

    r: 10,

  });
}
function loop() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  for (const b of balls) {
    b.vy += 0.25;
    b.x += b.vx;
    b.y += b.vy;
    if (b.x < b.r || b.x > canvas.width - b.r) b.vx *= -1;
    if (b.y < b.r || b.y > canvas.height - b.r) {
      b.vy *= -1;
      b.y = Math.max(b.r, Math.min(canvas.height - b.r, b.y));

    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fill();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

const paddle = { x: W / 2 - 40, w: 80 };
let ball;
let bricks;
let score = 0;
function reset() {
  ball = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, vx: 3, vy: -3 };
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < 5; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) bricks.push({ x: 10 + c * 58, y: 40 + r * 24, alive: true, color: `hsl(${r * 72}, 80%, 55%)` });
  score = 0;
}

  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") paddle.x -= 30;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") paddle.x += 30;
});

  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;
  if (ball.x < 8 || ball.x > W - 8) ball.vx *= -1;

    if (b.alive && ball.x > b.x && ball.x < b.x + 52 && ball.y > b.y && ball.y < b.y + 18) {
      b.alive = false;
      ball.vy *= -1;
      score++;
    }
  }
  if (bricks.every((b) => !b.alive)) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, 52, 18);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#db2777";
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, H - 24, paddle.w, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const balls = [];
for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) {
  balls.push({
    x: 40 + Math.random() * 320,
    y: 40 + Math.random() * 220,
    vx: (3 + Math.random()) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1),
    vy: (3 + Math.random()) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1),
    r: 10,
    color: "#16a34a",
  });
}
function loop() {
  ctx.clearRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
  for (const b of balls) {
    b.x += b.vx;
    b.y += b.vy;
    if (b.x < b.r || b.x > canvas.width - b.r) b.vx *= -1;
    if (b.y < b.r || b.y > canvas.height - b.r) {
      b.vy *= -1;
      b.y = Math.max(b.r, Math.min(canvas.height - b.r, b.y));
    }
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(b.x, b.y, b.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fill();
  }
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4f46e5";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);

  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";

}

let px = lanes[1];
let things = [];
let score = 0;
let best = 0;
let speed = 3;
let tick = 0;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" && lane > 0) lane--;

});
function reset() {

  score = 0;
  speed = 3;
  things = [];
}
function spawn() {
  const l = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
  const coin = false;
  things.push({ x: lanes[l], y: -40, coin });
}
function loop() {
  tick++;
  if (tick % Math.max(18, Math.floor(60 - speed * 4)) === 0) spawn();
  px += (lanes[lane] - px) * 0.25;
  speed += 0.002;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1f2937";

      if (t.coin) {
        score += 10;
        t.y = H + 100;
      } else {
        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }

  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);

    y: 40 + Math.random() * 220,
    vx: (3 + Math.random()) * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1),

body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;

<canvas id="c" width="360" height="520"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
let bird;
let pipes;
let score;
let frame;
function reset() {
  bird = { y: H / 2, v: 0 };
  pipes = [];
  score = 0;
  frame = 0;
}
function flap() {
  bird.v = -7;
}
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.code === "Space") flap();
});
canvas.addEventListener("click", flap);
function loop() {
  frame++;
  if (frame % 90 === 30) pipes.push({ x: W, top: 40 + Math.random() * (H - 110 - 80), passed: false });
  bird.v += 0.4;
  bird.y += bird.v;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#7dd3fc";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2563eb";
  for (const p of pipes) {
    p.x -= 2.5;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, 0, 52, p.top);
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.top + 110, 52, H);
    const hit = 80 > p.x && 80 < p.x + 52 && (bird.y < p.top || bird.y > p.top + 110);
    if (hit) reset();
    if (!p.passed && p.x + 52 < 80) {
      p.passed = true;
      score++;
    }
  }
  pipes = pipes.filter((p) => p.x > -60);
  if (bird.y > H || bird.y < 0) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#db2777";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(80, bird.y, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 28px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 8, 50);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }

  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9333ea";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

const canvas = document.getElementById("c");

const H = canvas.height;
const player = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, vx: 4, vy: 3, r: 8 };
let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;
});
document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});
function reset() {
  ball.x = W / 2;
  ball.y = H / 2;
  ball.vx = 4 * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
  ball.vy = 3;

  if (down) player.y += 5;
  player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - player.h, player.y));

  ball.x += ball.vx;
  ball.y += ball.vy;
  if (ball.y < ball.r || ball.y > H - ball.r) ball.vy *= -1;

    ball.vx *= -1.05;
    score++;
  }
  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#eab308";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#16a34a";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);

  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

const canvas = document.getElementById("c");

const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const player = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, vx: 4, vy: 3, r: 8 };
let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;

  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});

  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();

  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2563eb";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#16a34a";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);

  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

let bricks;

  ball = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, vx: 3, vy: -3 };
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < 5; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) bricks.push({ x: 10 + c * 58, y: 40 + r * 24, alive: true, color: `hsl(${r * 72}, 80%, 55%)` });

  if (bricks.every((b) => !b.alive)) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, 52, 18);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5563";
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, H - 24, paddle.w, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>

const lanes = [W / 6, W / 2, (W * 5) / 6];

let px = lanes[1];
let things = [];

const lanes = [W / 6, W / 2, (W * 5) / 6];

let px = lanes[1];
let things = [];
let score = 0;
let best = 0;
let speed = 4.5;
let tick = 0;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft" && lane > 0) lane--;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight" && lane < 2) lane++;
});
function reset() {
  best = Math.max(best, score);
  score = 0;
  speed = 4.5;
  things = [];
}

  const l = Math.floor(Math.random() * 3);
  const coin = false;
  things.push({ x: lanes[l], y: -40, coin });
}
function loop() {
  tick++;
  if (tick % Math.max(18, Math.floor(60 - speed * 4)) === 0) spawn();

    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();

    t.y += speed;
    if (t.coin) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();

      ctx.fillRect(t.x - 28, t.y - 18, 56, 36);

    if (Math.abs(t.y - (H - 60)) < 28 && Math.abs(t.x - px) < 30) {
      if (t.coin) {
        score += 10;
        t.y = H + 100;
      } else {
        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    }
  }
  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2563eb";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);

}

<title>Catch</title>

body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: #111827;
  color: #f9fafb;
}
canvas {
  border-radius: 10px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="420" height="480"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const basket = { x: W / 2 - 40, w: 80 };
let drops = [];
let score = 0;
let missed = 0;
let frame = 0;
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  basket.x = e.offsetX - basket.w / 2;
});
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") basket.x -= 30;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") basket.x += 30;
});
function loop() {
  if (frame++ % 40 === 0) drops.push({ x: 20 + Math.random() * (W - 40), y: -10, v: 2 + Math.random() * 2 });
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#38bdf8";
  for (const d of drops) {
    d.y += d.v;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    if (d.y > H - 30 && d.x > basket.x && d.x < basket.x + basket.w) {
      d.y = H + 100;
      score++;
    } else if (d.y > H && d.y < H + 50) {
      d.y = H + 100;
      missed++;
    }
  }
  drops = drops.filter((d) => d.y < H + 60);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0d9488";
  ctx.fillRect(basket.x, H - 24, basket.w, 16);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Caught: " + score + "   Missed: " + missed, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>
<|end|>

      if (t.coin) {
        score += 10;
        t.y = H + 100;
      } else {
        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    }
  }
  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5563";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);

const canvas = document.getElementById("c");

const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const player = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, vx: 4, vy: 3, r: 8 };
let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;

  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;

    ball.vx *= -1.05;

  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#9333ea";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#eab308";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);

  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();

let things = [];
let score = 0;
let best = 0;
let speed = 6.5;
let tick = 0;

      if (t.coin) {
        score += 10;
        t.y = H + 100;
      } else {
        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    }
  }
  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#db2777";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";

  for (let i = 0; i < 150; i++) {

const player = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };

let up = false;
let down = false;

  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#dc2626";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#16a34a";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

      if (t.coin) {
        score += 10;
        t.y = H + 100;
      } else {
        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    }
  }
  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5563";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);

  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";

}

    b.y += b.vy;
    if (b.x < b.r || b.x > canvas.width - b.r) b.vx *= -1;
    if (b.y < b.r || b.y > canvas.height - b.r) {

      b.y = Math.max(b.r, Math.min(canvas.height - b.r, b.y));

const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const basket = { x: W / 2 - 40, w: 80 };
let drops = [];
let score = 0;
let missed = 0;
let frame = 0;
canvas.addEventListener("mousemove", (e) => {
  basket.x = e.offsetX - basket.w / 2;

document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowLeft") basket.x -= 30;
  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") basket.x += 30;

  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#eab308";
  for (const d of drops) {
    d.y += d.v;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    if (d.y > H - 30 && d.x > basket.x && d.x < basket.x + basket.w) {
      d.y = H + 100;
      score++;

      d.y = H + 100;
      missed++;

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ea580c";

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Caught: " + score + "   Missed: " + missed, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";

  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

let ball;
let bricks;
let score = 0;
function reset() {
  ball = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, vx: 3, vy: -3 };
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) bricks.push({ x: 10 + c * 58, y: 40 + r * 24, alive: true, color: "#ea580c" });

  if (e.key === "ArrowRight") paddle.x += 30;
});

      b.alive = false;
      ball.vy *= -1;
      score++;

  if (bricks.every((b) => !b.alive)) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, 52, 18);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5563";
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, H - 24, paddle.w, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

let bird;

function reset() {
  bird = { y: H / 2, v: 0 };

  score = 0;

      score++;

  if (bird.y > H || bird.y < 0) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#dc2626";

  ctx.arc(80, bird.y, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";

  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";

const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
const player = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };
const ball = { x: W / 2, y: H / 2, vx: 4, vy: 3, r: 8 };
let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = true;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = true;
});
document.addEventListener("keyup", (e) => {
  if (e.key === "ArrowUp") up = false;
  if (e.key === "ArrowDown") down = false;
});
function reset() {
  ball.x = W / 2;
  ball.y = H / 2;
  ball.vx = 4 * (Math.random() < 0.5 ? -1 : 1);
  ball.vy = 3;
}
function loop() {
  if (up) player.y -= 5;
  if (down) player.y += 5;
  player.y = Math.max(0, Math.min(H - player.h, player.y));

  ball.y += ball.vy;

  if (ball.x < 24 && ball.y > player.y && ball.y < player.y + player.h && ball.vx < 0) {
    ball.vx *= -1.05;
    score++;
  }
  if (ball.x > W - 24 && ball.y > ai.y && ball.y < ai.y + ai.h && ball.vx > 0) ball.vx *= -1;
  if (ball.x < 0) {
    score = 0;
    reset();
  }
  if (ball.x > W) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#16a34a";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ea580c";
  ctx.fillRect(W - 18, ai.y, 8, ai.h);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

  if (tick % Math.max(18, Math.floor(60 - speed * 4)) === 0) spawn();

  speed += 0.002;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#1f2937";

  for (const x of [W / 3, (W * 2) / 3]) {
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.moveTo(x, 0);
    ctx.lineTo(x, H);
    ctx.stroke();
  }
  ctx.setLineDash([]);
  for (const t of things) {
    t.y += speed;
    if (t.coin) {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
      ctx.beginPath();
      ctx.arc(t.x, t.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
      ctx.fill();
    } else {
      ctx.fillStyle = "#0d9488";
      ctx.fillRect(t.x - 28, t.y - 18, 56, 36);
    }
    if (Math.abs(t.y - (H - 60)) < 28 && Math.abs(t.x - px) < 30) {
      if (t.coin) {
        score += 10;
        t.y = H + 100;
      } else {
        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    }
  }
  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4f46e5";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>

        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    }
  }
  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#4b5563";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";

      if (t.coin) {
        score += 10;
        t.y = H + 100;
      } else {
        reset();
        return requestAnimationFrame(loop);
      }
    }
  }
  things = things.filter((t) => t.y < H + 50);
  score += 0.1;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#dc2626";
  ctx.fillRect(px - 18, H - 80, 36, 40);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "18px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + Math.floor(score) + "   Best: " + Math.floor(best), 12, 26);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();

<head>

<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Flappy</title>
<style>
body {
  margin: 0;
  min-height: 100vh;
  display: grid;
  place-items: center;
  font-family: system-ui, sans-serif;
  background: #f5f5f7;
  color: #1f2937;
}
canvas {
  border-radius: 10px;
}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<canvas id="c" width="360" height="520"></canvas>
<script>
const canvas = document.getElementById("c");
const ctx = canvas.getContext("2d");
const W = canvas.width;
const H = canvas.height;
let bird;
let pipes;
let score;
let frame;
function reset() {
  bird = { y: H / 2, v: 0 };
  pipes = [];
  score = 0;
  frame = 0;
}
function flap() {
  bird.v = -7;
}
document.addEventListener("keydown", (e) => {
  if (e.code === "Space") flap();
});
canvas.addEventListener("click", flap);
function loop() {
  frame++;
  if (frame % 90 === 30) pipes.push({ x: W, top: 40 + Math.random() * (H - 110 - 80), passed: false });
  bird.v += 0.4;
  bird.y += bird.v;
  ctx.fillStyle = "#7dd3fc";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#2563eb";
  for (const p of pipes) {
    p.x -= 2.5;
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, 0, 52, p.top);
    ctx.fillRect(p.x, p.top + 110, 52, H);
    const hit = 80 > p.x && 80 < p.x + 52 && (bird.y < p.top || bird.y > p.top + 110);
    if (hit) reset();
    if (!p.passed && p.x + 52 < 80) {
      p.passed = true;
      score++;
    }
  }
  pipes = pipes.filter((p) => p.x > -60);
  if (bird.y > H || bird.y < 0) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#dc2626";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(80, bird.y, 14, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "bold 28px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 8, 50);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
reset();
loop();
</script>
</body>
</html>

let ball;
let bricks;
let score = 0;
function reset() {
  ball = { x: W / 2, y: H - 60, vx: 3, vy: -3 };
  bricks = [];
  for (let r = 0; r < 3; r++) for (let c = 0; c < 8; c++) bricks.push({ x: 10 + c * 58, y: 40 + r * 24, alive: true, color: `hsl(${r * 120}, 80%, 55%)` });

}

});

      b.alive = false;
      ball.vy *= -1;
      score++;
    }
  }
  if (bricks.every((b) => !b.alive)) reset();
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  for (const b of bricks) {
    if (!b.alive) continue;
    ctx.fillStyle = b.color;
    ctx.fillRect(b.x, b.y, 52, 18);
  }
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ea580c";
  ctx.fillRect(paddle.x, H - 24, paddle.w, 10);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, 7, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Score: " + score, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

loop();

const ai = { y: H / 2 - 30, h: 60 };

let score = 0;
let up = false;
let down = false;

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ea580c";
  ctx.fillRect(10, player.y, 8, player.h);

  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.beginPath();
  ctx.arc(ball.x, ball.y, ball.r, 0, Math.PI * 2);
  ctx.fill();
  ctx.font = "20px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText(score, W / 2 - 6, 28);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}

  ctx.fillStyle = "#0b1020";
  ctx.fillRect(0, 0, W, H);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#facc15";
  for (const d of drops) {
    d.y += d.v;
    ctx.beginPath();
    ctx.arc(d.x, d.y, 10, 0, Math.PI * 2);
    ctx.fill();
    if (d.y > H - 30 && d.x > basket.x && d.x < basket.x + basket.w) {
      d.y = H + 100;
      score++;
    } else if (d.y > H && d.y < H + 50) {
      d.y = H + 100;
      missed++;
    }
  }
  drops = drops.filter((d) => d.y < H + 60);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#0d9488";
  ctx.fillRect(basket.x, H - 24, basket.w, 16);
  ctx.fillStyle = "#ffffff";
  ctx.font = "16px system-ui";
  ctx.fillText("Caught: " + score + "   Missed: " + missed, 10, 22);
  requestAnimationFrame(loop);
}
loop();
</script>
